name: KraftGurus
headline: From discovering a workshop to booking a place.
summary: A website for exploring Indian arts experiences, with scheduling, payment and online delivery connected around the way KraftGurus works.
challengeTitle: A service worth discovering. A booking journey to match.
challenge: KraftGurus offers workshops, lectures and courses in Indian arts. The website needed to introduce these experiences and give customers a way to choose a session, book and pay.
approachTitle: A booking experience built around the service
approach: KraftGurus needed customers to explore its workshops, lectures and courses, then book and pay for a session.

We used WordPress to showcase the experiences. For this project, the standard shopping-cart process didn’t offer the booking journey we wanted, so we connected Calendly for scheduling, Stripe for payments and Microsoft Teams for online delivery.
Each platform had a clear role, allowing us to shape the website around how KraftGurus delivers its services.
detailTitle: Room for the craft. Clarity for the customer.
detail: Artwork and workshop imagery introduce the experiences. Dedicated pages bring the session format, duration and practical details together, so visitors can understand what they are booking.
deliveredTitle: One experience, supported by the right tools.

deliverables.title: A home for the experiences
deliverables.text: A WordPress website presenting workshops, lectures and courses, with individual pages for the sessions.

deliverables.title: Booking and payment setup
deliverables.text: Calendly scheduling connected with Stripe payments to support the session booking process.

deliverables.title: Online session delivery
deliverables.text: Microsoft Teams integrated into the setup for delivering online learning sessions.

name: Cheezzy Pizza
headline: A fresh website for browsing the menu and ordering online.
summary: An e-commerce redesign that brings the menu, product options and online ordering into the Cheezzy Pizza website.
challengeTitle: Make the menu part of the shopping experience.
challenge: Cheezzy Pizza needed a redesigned website that could present its food and support online orders. Customers needed to find their favourites, see the available options and know where to go next.
approachTitle: Built around the appetite to order.
approach: We redesigned and developed the website around the menu and shopping journey. Food imagery and direct ordering links make the products central to the experience.

Product categories organise pizzas, meals, starters and drinks. Product pages present the available choices, while branch information, contact details and FAQs support customers who need a little more information.
detail: The mobile website keeps food imagery, product names and ordering links within reach. Customers can browse the range and explore product options from their phone.
deliveredTitle: From a website visit to an online order.

deliverables.title: A redesigned storefront
deliverables.text: A refreshed website with food imagery, featured products and direct links into the online shop.

deliverables.title: An e-commerce catalogue
deliverables.text: Menu categories and product pages with options for customers to select before ordering.

deliverables.title: Useful customer information
deliverables.text: Branch details, FAQs and contact information alongside the shopping experience.

name: Odotastic
service: E-commerce, social media, Meta ads & Google Business Profile
headline: A place to discover stickers. A way to make them yours.
summary: An online store for sticker lovers, supported by social media strategy, content creation, Meta advertising and a Google Business Profile.
challengeTitle: Bring the brand online. Make ordering straightforward.
challenge: Odotastic needed an online presence and a place where art lovers could explore its stickers and place orders. Alongside the shop, the business needed a way to introduce its products to potential customers.
approachTitle: Build the shop, then help people discover it.
approach: We designed and developed an e-commerce website where customers could browse sticker collections, explore individual products and place an order. The shop gave Odotastic a dedicated home online and a destination to share through its marketing.
We also created a social media strategy and content for the brand, and supported its marketing with Meta ads. This work complemented the website by introducing the products through social channels.
To establish the business’s presence on Google Search, we created a Google Business Profile. The website, social media and business listing each played a part in making Odotastic accessible online.
detailTitle: Let the stickers do the talking.
detail: Product imagery puts the designs at the centre of the shopping experience. Collections help visitors explore styles that interest them, while product listings and ordering links give them a clear next step.
deliveredTitle: A storefront and the marketing to support it.

deliverables.title: An e-commerce website
deliverables.text: A website for exploring sticker collections, viewing products and placing orders online.

deliverables.title: Social strategy and content
deliverables.text: A social media strategy and content created to introduce the brand and showcase its products.

deliverables.title: Meta advertising
deliverables.text: Support with Meta ads as part of the brand’s social media marketing.

deliverables.title: Google Business Profile
deliverables.text: A business listing created to establish Odotastic’s presence on Google Search.

name: Frantomapa Educational Aid
headline: An important mission, brought into focus.
summary: A complete website redesign presenting Frantomapa’s education work, its programmes and the ways people can get involved.
challengeTitle: Help visitors understand the work and how to support it.
challenge: Frantomapa Educational Aid works to expand educational opportunity and STEM learning for underprivileged children in Ghana. Its website needed to bring that mission, its projects and ways to offer support together.
approachTitle: Start with the mission. Make the next step clear.
approach: We redesigned and developed the website to introduce Frantomapa’s purpose immediately, supported by photography of its education work.

Project highlights give visitors concrete examples of the organisation’s activities. Dedicated information about the team and programmes adds context, while donation information and contact routes give people a way to get involved.
detailTitle: The people and purpose stay at the centre.
detail: The mobile layout carries the mission and calls to action into a single-column reading experience. Visitors can discover the work, find donation information and contact the organisation.
deliveredTitle: A clear home for the mission and the work.

deliverables.title: A complete website redesign
deliverables.text: A refreshed visual design and page structure for introducing the organisation and its purpose.

deliverables.title: Projects and programmes
deliverables.text: Space to showcase education initiatives, the team and the Kidpreneurship programme.

deliverables.title: Ways to get involved
deliverables.text: Donation information, contact details and a WhatsApp link for enquiries and support.
